purpose: Define the immutable record that promotes one approved canonical snapshot to a named/versioned release while preserving approval, evidence, predecessor and distribution references.

topics.name: Canonical Release Record
topics.purpose: Define the immutable record that promotes one approved canonical snapshot to a named/versioned release while preserving approval, evidence, predecessor and distribution references.

semantics.predecessor_rule: Release records predecessor release/snapshot when applicable.
semantics.version_rule: Release version labels the released snapshot; it does not redefine contract identities.
semantics.distribution_rule: Release may reference one or more physical distribution packages/hashes.
semantics.immutability_rule: Published release record is immutable; correction creates a superseding record/release according to policy.
semantics.authority_rule: Release publication does not grant runtime authority.

invariants.rule: Release, replacement, rollback, deprecation and compatibility decisions remain explicit, snapshot-bound and traceable; no lifecycle label silently changes canonical semantics.

hard_gates.condition: version label changes underlying contract identity implicitly

references.purpose: Release promotes an immutable accepted snapshot.

prose.summary: Define the immutable record that promotes one approved canonical snapshot to a named/versioned release while preserving approval, evidence, predecessor and distribution references.
